name: Shortcuts
description: Create and manage main menu shortcuts for ROMs and Tools on NextUI.
author: Helaas

changelog.v2.2.2: Fixes shortcut art appearing doubled/ghosted by matching NextUI's own art position, size, and corner rounding exactly.
changelog.v2.2.1: Fixes blue-tinted shortcut artwork backgrounds caused by NextUI's RGBA theme color format.
changelog.v2.2.0: Fixes incorrect colors with NextUI's RGBA theme format.
changelog.v2.1.0: NextUI ≥ v6.11.0: X to Resume now works on ROM shortcuts. Cleaner Game Switcher & Recently Played with no duplicates or tool entries.
changelog.v2.0.0: Add Miyoo Flip support and ability to rename shortcuts. Major rework porting app from Gabagool to Apostrophe.
changelog.v1.1.1: ROMs inside subfolders now appear in the ROM picker and can be used to create shortcuts.
changelog.v1.1.0: Adds customizable shortcut artwork backgrounds, the ability to view hidden/disabled ROMs, renamed and streamlined artwork management and settings behavior, improved defaults, and easier setup for curated “five-game handheld” menus.
